Interface EffectivePermissions.ResourceSelector

All Known Implementing Classes:
EffectivePermissionsJson.ResourceSelectorJson
Enclosing interface:
EffectivePermissions
public static interface EffectivePermissions.ResourceSelector
An anyOf selector that is either an inclusion set (the listed values) or an exclusion set ({except: [...]}). Exactly one of getInclude() / getExcept() is populated for a given selector.
